Con {{scheme}}:// se habla con un solo s: With {{scheme}}:// the driver talks to one server only: for a cluster, such as Neo4j Aura, connect with neo4j+s:// (or neo4j://).
Deja la base de datos vacía para usar la: Leave the database empty to use the user's default database (on Neo4j Aura it is named after the instance id).
El servidor no encuentra la base de dato: The server cannot find this user's default database.
{{address}} responde, pero no se llega a: {{address}} answers, but the servers it gives for routing cannot be reached: check their advertised address (server.default_advertised_address) or, with a single server, connect with bolt://.
